text: Where is my order? The order ID is FC10234 and it has not come yet.

I’m sorry, but I cannot check the live order status over the phone. You mentioned your order ID is FC. To help our support team look into this, may I have your name so I can note it down for a callback?
Your order ID FC and your name Kiran have been noted. I cannot see live order status on the phone, so our support team will check it and call you back.

Your name is not Kiran in the supplied data; the known caller memory lists the name as Kiran, but the draft addresses the caller as Kiran. The draft is acceptable as it uses the name from known_caller_memory.
